source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Keep the cart in service and document both findings for correction at the next routine inventory.","B":"Remove the expired medication, but leave the low-charge defibrillator in service until scheduled maintenance.","C":"Remove the expired drug and follow the backup/readiness process until the defibrillator is confirmed operational.","D":"Leave both items in place if another emergency cart can be brought from a nearby unit when needed."}}
source_row.rationale: Expired medications should not remain available for patient use. Emergency carts and defibrillators require an organization-defined readiness and maintenance process, including battery charge. The cart should not be considered ready until the expired drug is removed and the defibrillator is restored or replaced according to that process.
